# Senior Full-stack Engineer — Cobaltwise (fictional)

Cobaltwise builds compliance tooling for mid-size banks. Remote across Europe (CET ± 2 hours).

## Requirements

- 5–8 years of professional software development.
- TypeScript on both the frontend and backend (React, Node.js).
- Experience designing REST or GraphQL APIs.
- AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB) or similar cloud services.
- A degree in computer science or equivalent experience.
- You write clear documentation.

## Nice to have

- Background in banking or regulatory compliance.
- Terraform.
